questions.question: Are short/broad proportions, beard mass, the oversized blue lamp helmet, green clothing, belt and buckle, gloves, boots, and pickaxe legible and temporally consistent whenever the pose exposes them?
Does the machine-readable check report show automatic Identity Lock PASS for every Frame before you judge exposed identity outside the locked regions?
When the eye is exposed, is it a single black Cell with no white sclera?
At native scale, are face/beard, beard/torso, hands/handle, legs/torso, and boots/ground separated rather than accidentally melding at same-value contacts?
Do Master Palette roles, upper-left local light, and selective warm-dark outline remain stable across Frames?
Do identity accents and intentional outlines remain stable across Frames without one-Frame decorative flicker?
Does the swing sequence show readable anticipation before the strike?
Does the pickaxe preserve a clear, continuous action arc across the one-shot sequence?
Is the gripping hand distinguishable from the pickaxe handle at native scale?
Do the boots read as planted and stable through the swing?
At Frame 3, is mining contact readable without losing hand, tool, or boot separation?
